tasks.label: iOS: build for Simulator
tasks.detail: Compiles the package for iOS without booting a simulator

tasks.label: iOS: build sample app
tasks.detail: Generates Example/SfereExample.xcodeproj with XcodeGen, then builds it for the Simulator without booting one
tasks.command: xcodegen generate --spec Example/project.yml --quiet && xcodebuild build -quiet -project Example/SfereExample.xcodeproj -scheme SfereExample -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator'

tasks.label: iOS: simulator flows
tasks.detail: Phase D2: boots one simulator, runs fresh install and upgrade with simctl, then the XCUITest flows against the mock; shuts the simulator down after. Heavy: check memory first

tasks.label: Parity: compare iOS and Android payloads
tasks.detail: Needs sfere-ios-sdk and sfere-android-sdk side by side. Checks the shared files match, runs the parity scenario on both SDKs and diffs the upload bodies

tasks.label: Mock ingest: start
tasks.detail: Starts tools/mock_ingest.mjs on port 4320, or reuses the one already running
